0022600183.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-4) host the Portland Trail Blazers (5-1) in the Suns' sixth game of the 2026-27 season. Phoenix is 3rd in the Pacific, 3.5 games back, and 12th in the West, has lost three straight, and is 0-3 on the road, while Portland is 1st in the Northwest, has won two straight, and is 4-0 on the road. The teams have met once this season, a 124-83 Suns loss in Portland on October 21, 2026, and the Suns won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, and Phoenix is also missing Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Jordan Goodwin (day-to-day, calf, game-time decision), while Portland is without Ja Morant (out, hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery).
